candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of usage, utilization, and related verb forms or roots in Romance languages, particularly Portuguese and Spanish.
This vector represents character sequences containing the letters 'fl' or the phonetic sound associated with flowing or liquid concepts.
This feature activates on lowercase and uppercase accented Latin vowels and characters common in French and other European languages.
This vector represents subword tokens and morphological fragments commonly found in Romance language roots and loanwords.
This vector represents common prefixes, initial phonemes, or morphological roots starting with the letter 'v'.
This vector represents various types of settings, environments, and structural sectors.
This vector represents the phoneme or subword string "an" across various capitalizations, languages, and contexts.
This feature vector activates on the letter sequence "arm" as a subword unit across various words and contexts.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens starting with the letter 'h' or 'H' across various languages.
This vector represents common Hungarian accented vowel characters and short stems containing them.
